sources.label: Baker, Chief Programmer Team, 2002 author overview
sources.access: Direct open returned 403; search returned the publisher page abstract, author, publication date and bibliography.
sources.verified_claim: The chief programmer leads the team and carries responsibility for a substantial programming project.
sources.bibliographic_boundary: The supplied URL is the author's 2002 encyclopedia overview, which cites the 1972 IBM Systems Journal article; it is not the 1972 article itself.
sources.not_claimed: No complete reading of the 1972 original or replication of its full staffing and methods.

sources.label: Tao et al., MAGIS, NeurIPS 2024
sources.verified_claim: The framework identifies Manager, Repository Custodian, Developer and Quality Assurance Engineer agent roles.
sources.adaptation_boundary: ProWorkSim borrows the role categories. Its sole final member001, patch selection, permissions and workflow are not asserted to reproduce MAGIS.

sources.label: Mintzberg, Structure in 5's, Management Science, 1980
sources.access: Publisher abstract and bibliographic record opened successfully.
sources.verified_claim: Coordination mechanisms include standardization of work processes, outputs and skills, as well as supervision and mutual adjustment.
sources.adaptation_boundary: A three-agent coding pipeline and exact version-bound stage transitions are this project's design, not an experiment reported in the source.

sources.label: Hong et al., MetaGPT, ICLR 2024
sources.verified_claim: MetaGPT uses SOP-based workflows, intermediate result checking and assembly-line role assignment.
sources.adaptation_boundary: Only the organizing principle is cited; PIPELINE3 is not presented as a complete MetaGPT replication.
